tools.name: search_archive
tools.description: Search historical photographs, documents, maps, articles, and events of the Alexandria Archive. Query can be Arabic or English (e.g. 'Stanley Bridge', 'كوم الدكة'). Returns titles and canonical URLs.

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Fetch one published article by numeric id — returns full markdown text in Arabic and English plus metadata.

tools.name: list_recent_articles
tools.description: List the most recently published articles (id, title, excerpt, date, URL).

tools.name: list_institutions
tools.description: List museums, libraries, archives and other institutions that publish their collections on the Alexandria Archive. Returns name, type, item count and canonical URL.

tools.name: get_institution
tools.description: Fetch a single institution by its slug — description, history, contact details, and a sample of its published archive items with canonical URLs. Use this to answer questions about a specific institution's holdings, or to find items available for licensing.

tools.name: list_upcoming_events
tools.description: List the Alexandria Archive's upcoming events — heritage walks, workshops, talks — soonest first, with date, place, price in Egyptian pounds (or free) and the page where a person books a seat. Use for questions like 'what is on in Alexandria this week' or 'a history walk in Alexandria'.

tools.name: list_store_products
tools.description: List products on sale in the Alexandria Archive's store — prints, books and gifts about the city — with price in Egyptian pounds and the product page. Sales support the archive.

tools.name: get_licensing_info
tools.description: Explain how an image or document from the Alexandria Archive may be reused or licensed (publication, broadcast, commercial use), and where the request is made. Pass itemId for one archive record; omit it for the general terms.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_archive, list_recent_articles, list_institutions, get_institution · Private data: search_archive, get_institution, get_licensing_info · Public sink: list_institutions, get_licensing_info.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_archive, list_recent_articles, list_institutions, get_institution · Private data: search_archive, get_institution, get_licensing_info · Public sink: list_institutions, get_licensing_info

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
